segs.en: After the repetition, say Vidui and Nefilat Apayim, and then say:
segs.text: <small>אחר החזרה אומרים וידוי ונפילת אפים, ואחר־כך אומרים:</small>

עַל יְדֵי רַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִֽינוּ, כִּי בְרוֹב אִוַּלְתֵּנוּ שָׁגִֽינוּ: מְחֹל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, כִּי רַבּוּ עֲוֹנֵֽינוּ: אֵל אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם אַתָּה, וְדֶרֶךְ תְּשׁוּבָה לָנוּ הוֹרֵיתָ: גְּדֻלַּת רַחֲמֶיךָ וַחֲסָדֶיךָ, תִּזְכּוֹר הַיּוֹם לְזֶרַע יְדִידֶיךָ: תֵּפֶן אֵלֵֽינוּ בְּרַחֲמִים, כִּי אַתָּה הוּא בַּעַל הָרַחֲמִים: בְּתַחֲנוּן וּבִתְפִלָּה נְקַדֵּם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם: וּמֵחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ תָּשׁוּב, כְּמוֹ בְּתוֹרָֽתְךָ כָּתוּב: וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ נֶחֱסֶה וְנִתְלוֹנָן, כְּיוֹם וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן: תַּעֲבֹר עַל פֶּשַׁע וְתִמְחֹל אָשָׁם, כְּיוֹם וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם: תַּאֲזִין שֶׁוַע וְתָּקְשִׁיב בְּרָצוֹן מַאֲמָר, כְּיוֹם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה: וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙׃

אָֽבְלָה נַפְשִׁי וְחָשַׁךְ תָּאֳרִי, בֵּית תִּפְאַרְתִּי נִשְׂרַף בְּיַד הָאֲרִי, גַּם פְּלֵטִים אֲשֶׁר עָֽזְבוּ שְׁאֵרִי, דּוֹעֲכוּ הַיּוֹם בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה בְתִשְׁרִי: הַמַּיִם הַזֵּדוֹנִים שְׁטָפוּנוּ בְּדָלְקָם, וּבוֹסְסוּ צָרִים מִקְדָּשִׁי וּבָֽזְזוּ חֶלְקָם, זִקְנֵי שְׁאֵרִית אֲשֶׁר נִמְלְטוּ בְּיוֹם נָקָם, חֻבְּלוּ הַיּוֹם עִם גְּדַלְיָה בֶּן אֲחִיקָם: טוֹרְפוּ עֲנִיֵּי עַם הָאָרֶץ, יֶתֶר הַגָּזָם אָכַל הָאַרְבֶּה בְּמֶרֶץ, כּוֹרְמִים וְיוֹגְבִים אֲשֶׁר הִפְקִיד נְגִיד הָאָרֶץ, לֻקְּטוּ הַיּוֹם וְלֹא הָיָה בָהֶם גּוֹדֵר גָּדֵר וְעוֹמֵד בַּפֶּרֶץ: מָה אֲסַפֵּר וְאַנְחוֹתַי עֲצוּמוֹת, נָֽקְטָה נַפְשִׁי וּמִקְהֲלוֹתַי עֲגוּמוֹת, שְׂרִידַי אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאֲרוּ מֵחֶרֶב וְחֵמוֹת, עוֹד הֵם לֹא נִתְקַיְּמוּ וְנוֹתְצוּ בַחוֹמוֹת: פָּנֶיךָ עַד אָנָה מִמֶּנּוּ תַסְתִּיר, צַוְחָתֵנוּ תִּשְׁמַע וְכַבְלֵנוּ תַתִּיר, קָדוֹשׁ הַבִּיטָה בְעֹנְיֵנוּ כִּי אֵין לָנוּ מַכְתִּיר, רְאֵה דַלּוּתֵנוּ וְשֶׁבַח לְפָנֶיךָ נַעְתִּיר: שֻׁדַּדְנוּ מִדּוֹר לְדוֹר וּמִקֵּץ לְקֵץ, שֹׁרֶשׁ צֶפַע אוֹתָנוּ עִקֵּץ, תַּקִּיף לְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ הָעִירָה וְהָקֵץ, וּתְכַפֵּר חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ וְתֹאמַר לְקָרֵב קֵץ: יֶהֱמוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ עַל מְעוּטֵי עַמִּים, וְשַׂגְּבֵם בְּחַסְדֶּךָ לְעֵינֵי כָל לְאֻמִּים, פְּלָאֶיךָ הַרְאֵם שׁוֹכֵן מְרוֹמִים, אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים:

אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים וּמִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ, מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן. מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לַחַטָּאִים, וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים. עֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל־בָּשָׂר וְרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם לָהֶם גּוֹמֵל. אֵל הוֹרֵתָנוּ לוֹמַר מִדּוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, זְכֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙׃

אַנְשֵׁי אֱמוּנָה אָבָדוּ, בָּאִים בְּכֹחַ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם: גִּבּוֹרִים לַעֲמֹד בַּפֶּרֶץ, דּוֹחִים אֶת־הַגְּזֵרוֹת: הָיוּ לָנוּ לְחוֹמָה, וּלְמַחְסֶה בְּיוֹם זָעַם: זוֹעֲכִים אַף בְּלַחֲשָׁם, חֵמָה עָֽצְרוּ בְּשַׁוְּעָם: טֶרֶם קְרָאוּךָ עֲנִיתָם, יוֹדְעִים לַעֲתֹר וּלְרַצּוֹת: כְּאָב רִחַמְתָּ לְמַעֲנָם, לֹא הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ פְנֵיהֶם רֵיקָם: מֵרֹב עֲוֹנֵֽינוּ אֲבַדְנוּם, נֶאֶסְפוּ מֶנּוּ בַּחֲטָאֵֽינוּ: סָעוּ הֵמָּה לִמְנוּחוֹת, עָֽזְבוּ אוֹתָנוּ לַאֲנָחוֹת: פַּסּוּ גוֹדְרֵי גָדֵר, צֻמְּתוּ מְשִׁיבֵי חֵמָה: קָמִים בַּפֶּרֶץ אַיִן, רְאוּיִים לְרַצּוֹתְךָ אָפֵסוּ: שׁוֹטַטְנוּ בְּאַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת, תְּרוּפָה לֹא מָצָאנוּ: שַׁבְנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּבֹשֶׁת פָּנֵֽינוּ, לְשַׁחֲרָךְ אֵל בְּעֵת צָרוֹתֵֽינוּ:

אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים וּמִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ, מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן. מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לַחַטָּאִים, וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים. עֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל־בָּשָׂר וְרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם לָהֶם גּוֹמֵל. אֵל הוֹרֵתָנוּ לוֹמַר מִדּוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, זְכֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙׃

תָּמַהְנוּ מֵרָעוֹת, תָּשַׁשׁ כֹּחֵנוּ מִצָּרוֹת. שַׁחְנוּ עַד לִמְאֹד, שָׁפַלְנוּ עַד עָפָר. רַחוּם כָּךְ הִיא מִדָּתֵנוּ, קְשֵׁי עֹרֶף וּמַמְרִים אֲנַחְנוּ. צָעַקְנוּ בְּפִֽינוּ חָטָאנוּ, פְּתַלְתּוֹל וְעִקֵּשׁ לִבֵּנוּ. עֶלְיוֹן רַחֲמֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם, סְלִיחָה עִמְּךָ הִיא. נִחָם עַל הָרָעָה, מַטֵּה כְלַפֵּי חֶסֶד. לֹא תִתְעַלַּם בְּעִתּוֹת כָּאֵל, כִּי בְצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָחְנוּ. יִוָּדַע לְעֵינֵי הַכֹּל, טוּבְךָ וְחַסְדְּךָ עִמָּנוּ. חֲתֹם פֶּה־שָׂטָן, וְאַל יַשְׂטִין עָלֵֽינוּ, זְעֹם בּוֹ וְיִדֹּם. וְיַעֲמֹד מֵלִיץ טוֹב לְצַדְּקֵנוּ, הוּא יַגִּיד יָשְׁרֵנוּ. דְּרָכֶיךָ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן גִּלִּיתָ לְנֶאֱמַן בָּיִת. בְּבַקְשׁוֹ אָז מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, אֱמוּנָֽתְךָ הוֹדַעְתָּ לּוֹ:

אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים וּמִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ, מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן. מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לַחַטָּאִים, וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים. עֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל־בָּשָׂר וְרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם לָהֶם גּוֹמֵל. אֵל הוֹרֵתָנוּ לוֹמַר מִדּוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, זְכֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙׃

וּכְשֶׁחָֽטְאוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר, עָמַד מֹשֶׁה בִּתְפִלָּה לְפָנֶיךָ, וּבִקֵּשׁ רַחֲמִים עַל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָךְ אָמַר בִּתְפִלָּתוֹ: סְלַֽח־נָ֗א לַעֲוֺ֛ן הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּגֹ֣דֶל חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתָה֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־הֵֽנָּה׃ אַף אַתָּה הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ לוֹ כְּדַרְכֵי טוּבְךָ בִּשַּׂרְתּוֹ וַחֲנַנְתּוֹ וְאָמַרְתָּ לוֹ: סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶךָ:

דָּנִיֵּאל אִישׁ חֲמוּדוֹת אָמַר לְפָנֶיךָ: הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י ׀ אׇזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשְׁמָע֒ פקחה [פְּקַ֣ח] עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י ׀ לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃ אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקְשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעַנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃ וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִירָךְ אָמַרְתָּ לָהּ: הִנְנִי֙ נִשְׁפָּ֣ט אוֹתָ֔ךְ עַל־אׇמְרֵ֖ךְ לֹ֥א חָטָֽאתִי׃ אֲנַחְנוּ בּוֹשְׁנוּ בְּמַעֲשֵֽׂינוּ וְנִכְלַמְנוּ בַּעֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֵין לָנוּ פֶּה לְהָשִׁיב וְלֹא מֵצַח לְהָרִים רֹאשׁ:

segs.en: According to the order of Aleph-Tet, Bet-Shin
segs.text: <small>על סדר א"ת ב"ש</small>

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אַל תַּעַשׂ עִמָּנוּ כָּלָה, תֹּאחֵז יָֽדְךָ בַּמִּשְׁפָּט. בְּבֹא תוֹכֵחָה נֶגְדֶּךָ, שְׁמֵנוּ מִסִּפְרְךָ אַל תֶּמַח. גִּשְׁתְּךָ לַחֲקֹר מוּסָר, רַחֲמֶיךָ יְקַדְּמוּ רָגְזֶךָ. דַּלּוּת מַעֲשִׂים בְּשׁוּרֶךָ, קָרֵב צֶדֶק מֵאֵלֶיךָ. הוֹרֵנוּ בְּזַעֲקֵנוּ לָךְ, צַו יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ בְּמַפְגִּיעַ. וְתָשִׁיב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי תָם, פְּתָחָיו רְאֵה כִּי שָׁמֵמוּ. זְכֹר נָאַמְתָּ, עֵדוּת לֹא תִשָּׁכַח מִפִּי זַרְעוֹ. חוֹתָם תְּעוּדָה תַּתִּיר, סוֹדְךָ שִׂים בְּלִמּוּדֶיךָ. טַבּוּר אַגַּן הַסַּהַר, נָא אַל יֶחְסַר הַמָּזֶג. יָהּ דַּע אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יְדָעוּךָ, מַגֵּר אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדָעוּךָ. כִּי תָשִׁיב לְבִצָּרוֹן, לְכוּדִים אֲסִירֵי הַתִּקְוָה:

אָשַׁמְנוּ מִכָּל־עָם, בֹּשְׁנוּ מִכָּל־גּוֹי. גָּלָה מִמֶּנּוּ מָשׂוֹשׂ, דָּוֶה לִבֵּנוּ בַּחֲטָאֵֽינוּ. הָחְבַּל אֶוְיֵֽינוּ, וְנִפְרָע פְּאֵרֵנוּ. זְבוּל מִקְדָּשֵׁנוּ, חָרֵב בַּעֲוֹנֵֽינוּ. טִירָתֵנוּ הָֽיְתָה לְשַׁמָּה, יְפִי אַדְמָתֵנוּ לְזָרִים, כֹּחֵנוּ לְנָכְרִים. לְעֵינֵינוּ עָֽשְׁקוּ עֲמָלֵנוּ, מְמֻשָּׁךְ וּמוֹרָט מִמֶּנּוּ. נָֽתְנוּ עֻלָּם עָלֵֽינוּ, סָבַלְנוּ עַל שִׁכְמֵנוּ. עֲבָדִים מָֽשְׁלוּ בָנוּ, פּוֹרֵק אֵין מִיָּדָם. צָרוֹת רַבּוֹת סְבָבוּנוּ, קְרָאנוּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ. רָחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנּוּ בַּעֲוֹנֵֽינוּ, שַׁבְנוּ מֵאַחֲרֶיךָ, תָּעִֽינוּ כַּצֹּאן וְאָבָֽדְנוּ. וַעֲדַיִן לֹא שַׁבְנוּ מִתְּעִיָּתֵנוּ, וְהֵיאַךְ נָעִיז פָּנֵֽינוּ, וְנַקְשֶׁה עָרְפֵּנוּ, לוֹמַר לְפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַחְנוּ וְלֹא־חָטָאנוּ:

עֶזְרָא הַסּוֹפֵר אָמַר לְפָנֶיךָ: אֱלֹהַי֙ בֹּ֣שְׁתִּי וְנִכְלַ֔מְתִּי לְהָרִ֧ים אֱלֹהַ֛י פָּנַ֖י אֵלֶ֑יךָ כִּ֣י עֲוֺנֹתֵ֤ינוּ רָבוּ֙ לְמַ֣עְלָה רֹּ֔אשׁ וְאַשְׁמָתֵ֥נוּ גָדְלָ֖ה עַ֥ד לַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ וְאַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת, חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם, אֶרֶךְ־אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד, וְלֹא עֲזַבְתָּם. אַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ אָבִֽינוּ, אַל תִּטְּשֵׁנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, וְאַל תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ יוֹצְרֵנוּ, וְאַל תַּעַשׂ עִמָּנוּ כָלָה בְּגָלוּתֵנוּ, וְקַיֵּם לָנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּנוּ, עַל יְדֵי יִרְמְיָה חוֹזָךְ, כָּאָמוּר: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֩ וּבָעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜יא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה יְבֻקַּ֞שׁ אֶת־עֲוֺ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאֵינֶ֔נּוּ וְאֶת־חַטֹּ֥את יְהוּדָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תִמָּצֶ֑אינָה כִּ֥י אֶסְלַ֖ח לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אַשְׁאִֽיר׃ וְאַל יְעַכֵּב לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל־חֵטְא וְעוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ, וּמְחוֹל וּסְלַח לְכָל־עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָתָּה:

מַה־נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מָרוֹם, וּמַה נְּסַפֵּר לְפָנֶיךָ שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים, הֲלֹא הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת וְהַנִּגְלוֹת אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ, אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ רָזֵי עוֹלָם, וְתַעֲלוּמוֹת סִתְרֵי כָל־חָי, אַתָּה חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל־חַדְרֵי בָטֶן, רֹאֶה כְלָיוֹת וָלֵב. אֵין דָּבָר נֶעְלָם מִמָּךְ, וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ:

יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁתִּמְחֹל לָנוּ אֶת־כָּל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ, וּתְכַפֵּר לָנוּ אֶת־כָּל־עֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ, וְתִמְחֹל וְתִסְלַח לְכָל־פְּשָׁעֵינוּ, וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ: סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ, מְחֹל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי פָשָֽׁעְנוּ: כִּי אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי, טוֹב וְסַלָּח, וְרַב־חֶסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ: לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃ לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓ ׀ תּוֹצִ֖יא מִצָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֨נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַֽעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ׃ הֲשִׁיבֵ֨נוּ יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ ונשוב [וְֽנָשׁ֔וּבָה] חַדֵּ֥שׁ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם׃

וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם ׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַֽ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־יָ֝עִ֗יר כׇּל־חֲמָתֽוֹ׃ אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹֽא־תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ ׀ יְהֹ֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ: אִם־עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמׇר־יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃ כִּֽי־עִמְּךָ֥ הַסְּלִיחָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן תִּוָּרֵֽא׃ לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃ אִם־עֲוֺנֵ֙ינוּ֙ עָ֣נוּ בָ֔נוּ יְהֹוָ֕ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ׃ זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃ יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ מַעֲשִׂים. עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ צְדָקָה כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ:

parts.text: אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ הוֹצֵ֨אתָ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֜ מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה וַתַּֽעַשׂ־לְךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה חָטָ֖אנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃ אֲדֹנָ֗י כְּכׇל־צִדְקֹתֶ֙ךָ֙ יָֽשׇׁב־נָ֤א אַפְּךָ֙ וַחֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ מֵעִֽירְךָ֥ יְרוּשָׁלַ֖‍ִם הַר־קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ כִּ֤י בַחֲטָאֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּבַעֲוֺנ֣וֹת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ֧‍ִם וְעַמְּךָ֛ לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לְכָל־סְבִיבֹתֵֽינוּ׃ וְעַתָּ֣ה ׀ שְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְאֶל־תַּ֣חֲנוּנָ֔יו וְהָאֵ֣ר פָּנֶ֔יךָ עַל־מִקְדָּשְׁךָ֖ הַשָּׁמֵ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן אֲדֹנָֽי׃ הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י ׀ אׇזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשְׁמָע֒ פקחה [פְּקַ֣ח] עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י ׀ לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃ אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקְשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעַנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃ אָבִינוּ אָב הָרַחֲמָן,

הַרְאֵנוּ אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְקַבֵּץ נְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ. יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל הַגּוֹיִם כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אָבִינוּ אָתָּה. אֲנַחְנוּ הַחֹמֶר וְאַתָּה יֹצְרֵנוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדְךָ כֻּלָּנוּ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ,

ח֧וּסָה יְהֹוָ֣ה עַל־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וְאַל־תִּתֵּ֨ן נַחֲלָתְךָ֤ לְחֶרְפָּה֙ לִמְשׇׁל־בָּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם לָ֚מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ בָעַמִּ֔ים אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ יָדַעְנוּ יְהֹוָה כִּי חָטָאנוּ. וְאֵין מִי יַעֲמוֹד בַּעֲדֵנוּ אֶלָּא שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל יַעֲמוֹד לָנוּ בְּעֵת צָרָה. וּכְרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ. חֲמֹל עַל עַמָּךְ וְרַחֵם עַל נַחֲלָתָךְ. חוּסָה נָּא כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ חָנֵּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַצְּדָקָה עוֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת בְּכָל עֵת וָעֵת. הַבֵּט נָא וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא צֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ. אַל יִמְשָׁל בָּנוּ קֶצֶף כִּי לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיְשׁוּעָה בְּךָ תוֹחַלְתֵּנוּ. אֱלוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת אָנָּא סְלַח נָא. כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָתָּה:

segs.text: אָנָּא מֶלֶךְ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן, זְכוֹר וְהַבֵּט לִבְרִית בֵּין הַבְּתָרִים. וְתֵרָאֶה לְפָנֶיךָ עֲקֵדַת יָחִיד. וּלְמַעַן יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִינוּ. אַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ אָבִינוּ. וְאַל תִּטְּשֵׁנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וְאַל תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ יוֹצְרֵנוּ. וְאַל תַּעַשׂ עִמָּנוּ כָלָה בְּגָלוּתֵינוּ. כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה:

אֵין כָּמוֹךָ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֱלֹהֵינוּ. אֵין כָּמוֹךָ אֵל אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת. הושִׁיעֵנוּ וְרַחֲמֵנוּ מֵרַעַשׁ וּמֵרֹגֶז הַצִּילֵנוּ: זְכֹר֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב אַל־תֵּ֗פֶן אֶל־קְשִׁי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאֶל־רִשְׁע֖וֹ וְאֶל־חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃ שׁ֚וּב מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔ךָ וְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־הָרָעָ֖ה לְעַמֶּֽךָ׃ וְהָסֵר מִמֶּנּוּ מַכַּת הַמָּוֶת כִּי רַחוּם אָתָּה. כִּי כֵן דַּרְכְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת חֶסֶד חִנָּם בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָנָּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָֽא׃ אָנָּא יְהֹוָה עֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵנוּ: לְךָ יְהֹוָה קִוִּינוּ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה חִכִּינוּ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה נְיַחֵל אַל תֶּחֱשֶׁה וּתְעַנֵּנוּ. כִּי נָאֲמוּ גוֹיִם אָבְדָה תִקְוָתָם. כָּל בֶּרֶךְ לְךָ תִכְרַע וְכָל קוֹמָה לְפָנֶיךָ תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה:

הַפּוֹתֵחַ יָד בִּתְשׁוּבָה לְקַבֵּל פּוֹשְׁעִים וְחַטָּאִים. נִבְהֲלָה נַפְשֵׁנוּ מֵרוֹב עִצְּבוֹנֵנוּ. אַל תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ נֶצַח קוּמָה וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. אַל תִּשְׁפּוֹךְ חֲרוֹנְךָ עָלֵינוּ כִּי עַמְּךָ אֲנַחְנוּ בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ. אֵל הַבִּיטָה. דַּל כְּבוֹדֵנוּ בַגּוֹיִם וְשִׁקְּצוּנוּ כְּטֻמְאַת הַנִּדָּה. עַד מָתַי עֻזְּךָ בַּשְּׁבִי וְתִפְאַרְתְּךָ בְּיַד צָר. הֵמָּה יִרְאוּ וְיֵבֹשׁוּ וְיֵחַתּוּ מִגְּבוּרָתָם. עוֹרְרָה גְבוּרָתְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ. אַל יִמְעֲטוּ לְפָנֶיךָ תְּלָאוֹתֵינוּ מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ בְּעֵת צָרוֹתֵנוּ. לֹא לְמַעֲנֵנוּ אֶלָּא לְמַעֲנָךְ פְּעֹל וְאַל תַּשְׁחֵת אֶת זֵכֶר שְׁאֵרִיתֵנוּ. כִּי לְךָ מְיַחֲלוֹת עֵינֵינוּ כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה. וּזְכוֹר עֵדוּתֵינוּ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד אוֹמְרִים פַּעֲמַיִם בְּאַהֲבָה: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ אֶחָֽד׃

segs.en: And the chazzan says Half Kaddish, the Torah is taken out, three people are called for the portion of Vayechal, and the prayer is concluded as on every day. After Hoshi'enu, say Shir Mizmor LeAsaf, Elohim El Dami Lecha.
segs.text: <small>ואומר הש"ץ חצי קדיש, ומוציאים ס"ת, וקוראים ג' עולים בפרשת ויחל, וגומרים התפלה כבכל יום, ואחר הושיענו אומרים שיר מזמור לאסף, אלהים אל דמי לך.</small>

Through Your abundant mercies, forgive us, our Father, for in the multitude of our folly we have erred; pardon us, our King, for our iniquities are many. You are a God slow to anger, and You have taught us the way of repentance. Remember today the greatness of Your mercies and Your kindnesses for the descendants of Your beloved. Turn to us with compassion, for You are the Master of compassion. With supplication and prayer we come before You, as You made known to the humble one of old. Turn back from Your burning anger, as it is written in Your Torah. In the shadow of Your wings we take refuge and find shelter, as on the day when “Hashem descended in a cloud”; pass over transgression and pardon guilt, as on the day when “He stood with him there”; hear our cry and give ear favorably to our plea, as on the day when “he proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

My soul mourns and my features have darkened; my glorious house was burned by the hand of the lion. Even the survivors whom my kin left behind were snuffed out this day, on the third of Tishrei. The raging waters swept us away in their burning wrath; enemies trampled my Sanctuary and plundered their share. The elders of the remnant, who had escaped on the day of vengeance, were destroyed this day together with Gedaliah son of Ahikam. The poor of the land were torn to pieces, and what the cutter left, the locust devoured with force; the vinedressers and husbandmen whom the governor of the land had appointed were gathered up this day, and there was none among them to repair the fence and stand in the breach. What shall I recount, when my sighs are mighty? My soul is weary and my assemblies are grieved. My survivors who remained from the sword and from fury had not yet been established when they were torn down within the walls. How long will You hide Your face from us? Hear our outcry and loosen our shackles. Holy One, look upon our affliction, for we have none to crown us; see our poverty, and we shall plead before You with praise. We have been plundered from generation to generation and from end to end; the root of the viper has stung us. Mighty One, awaken Your judgments and arouse them, and atone for our sins, and say that the end be hastened. May Your mercies stir for the smallest of the peoples; raise them high with Your kindness in the sight of all nations. Show them Your wonders, You who dwell on high, God, King who sits on the throne of mercy.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Hashem descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

Men of faith have perished, those who came by the strength of their deeds, mighty to stand in the breach, who turned away the decrees. They were a wall for us, and a refuge on the day of wrath. They extinguished anger with their whispered prayer and held back fury with their cry. Before they called You, You answered them; they knew how to entreat and to appease. As a father You had compassion for their sake; You did not turn their faces away empty. Through our many iniquities we lost them; they were gathered away from us through our sins. They have gone to their rest and left us to sighing. The builders of the fence have ceased; those who turned back wrath are cut off. None is left standing in the breach; those worthy of appeasing You have ceased. We have wandered to the four corners; we found no remedy. We have come back to You in shame, to seek You, God, in the time of our troubles.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Hashem descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

We are astounded by evils; our strength has failed from troubles. We have sunk exceedingly low; we have been brought down to the dust. Merciful One, such is our nature: we are stiff-necked and rebellious. We cried out with our mouths, “We have sinned,” and our heart is crooked and twisted. Most High, Your mercies are from of old; forgiveness is with You. Relent from the evil; incline toward kindness. Do not hide Yourself in times of trouble, O God, for we are in great distress. Let Your goodness and Your kindness toward us be known before the eyes of all. Seal the mouth of the accuser, and let him not accuse us; rage against him, and let him be silenced. Let a good advocate arise to vindicate us; let him declare our uprightness. Your ways, Merciful and Gracious One, You revealed to the faithful one of the house; when he sought them from You then, You made Your faithfulness known to him.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Hashem descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

When Israel sinned in the wilderness, Moses stood in prayer before You and sought mercy for Your people Israel, and this is what he said in his prayer: “Pardon, please, the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of Your kindness, and as You have borne this people from Egypt until now.” And You, too, answered him in Your good ways, bringing him good tidings and showing him grace, and You said to him: “I have pardoned, as you have asked.”

Daniel, the man most beloved, said before You: “Incline Your ear, my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see our desolation, and the city upon which Your name is called; for not on account of our righteousness do we lay our supplications before You, but on account of Your abundant mercies. My Lord, hear; my Lord, forgive; my Lord, attend and act; do not delay, for Your own sake, my God, for Your name is called upon Your city and upon Your people.” You said to her: “Behold, I will enter into judgment with you for your saying, ‘I have not sinned.’” We are ashamed of our deeds and humiliated by our iniquities; we have no mouth to answer and no boldness to lift our heads.

Our God and God of our fathers, do not make an end of us. Withhold Your hand in judgment when reproof comes before You; do not blot out our name from Your book. Come close to investigate [our] discipline; may Your mercies precede Your anger. Observe our poor deeds; bring righteousness near of Your own accord. Instruct us when we cry to You; command our salvation through the Intercessor. Restore the captivity of the tents of the perfect; see their gates, for they are desolate. Remember the faithful testimony; do not forget it from the mouth of his seed. Loosen the sealed testimony; place Your secret in our learning, the center of the rounded basin: let the mixed wine not be lacking. Yah, know Israel, who have known You; cast down the nations that have not known You. For You will restore to the stronghold the prisoners of hope.

We are guiltier than any people, more ashamed than any nation. Joy has departed from us; our heart is sick through our sins. Our desire has been ruined and our glory stripped away; the dwelling of our Sanctuary lies in ruins through our iniquities. Our palace has become desolate; the beauty of our land is given to strangers, our strength to foreigners. Before our eyes our toil was plundered; what we had was drawn and stripped from us. A yoke was set upon us and we bore it on our shoulder; slaves ruled over us, and none could free us from their hand. Many troubles surrounded us; we called to You, Hashem our God. You were far from us because of our iniquities; we turned back from following You, we strayed like sheep and were lost. And we have not yet turned from our error. How then can we brazenly stiffen our necks, to say before You, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, “We are righteous and have not sinned”?

Ezra the scribe said before You: “My God, I am ashamed and humiliated to lift my face to You, my God, for our iniquities have risen above our heads, and our guilt has grown up to the heavens.” But You are a God of pardons, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in kindness, and You did not forsake them. Do not forsake us, our Father; do not abandon us, our King; do not forget us, our Maker; and do not make an end of us in our exile. And fulfill for us, Hashem our God, the word You promised us through Jeremiah, Your seer, as it is said: “In those days and at that time, declares Hashem, the iniquity of Israel will be sought, and there will be none, and the sins of Judah, and they will not be found, for I will pardon those whom I leave.” Let no sin or iniquity stand in the way of our prayer before You, and pardon and forgive all our iniquities, for You are a good and forgiving God.

What shall we say before You, You who dwell on high, and what shall we recount before You, You who abide in the heavens? Is it not that You know all that is hidden and all that is revealed? You know the secrets of the world and the hidden mysteries of every living being. You search all the chambers of the belly; You see the kidneys and the heart. Nothing is hidden from You, and nothing is concealed from before Your eyes.

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that You forgive us all our sins, atone for all our iniquities, and pardon and forgive all our transgressions; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us as Your inheritance. Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed. For You, Lord, are good and forgiving, abounding in kindness to all who call upon You. For Your name’s sake, Hashem, pardon my iniquity, for it is great. For Your name’s sake, Hashem, You will give me life; in Your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble. Hashem of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our stronghold, Selah. Hashem of Hosts, happy is the person who trusts in You. Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call. Bring us back to You, Hashem, and we shall return; renew our days as of old.

And He, the Merciful, forgives iniquity and does not destroy; He often turns back His anger and does not stir up all His wrath. You, Hashem, will not withhold Your mercies from me; Your kindness and Your truth will always guard me. Save us, Hashem our God, and gather us from the nations, to give thanks to Your holy Name and to glory in Your praise. If You, Yah, should keep iniquities, Lord, who could stand? For with You is forgiveness, so that You may be feared. He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our iniquities. If our iniquities testify against us, Hashem, act for Your name’s sake. Remember Your mercies, Hashem, and Your kindnesses, for they are from of old. May Hashem answer you on the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you. Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call. Our Father, our King, be gracious to us and answer us, for we have no worthy deeds; deal with us in charity according to Your abundant mercy, and save us for Your name’s sake.

And now, my Lord our God, who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and made a name for Yourself, as this very day—we have sinned, we have acted wickedly. My Lord, according to all Your righteous acts, let Your anger and Your wrath turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people have become a reproach to all around us. And now, our God, hear the prayer of Your servant and his supplications, and cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate Sanctuary, for the sake of the Lord. Incline Your ear, my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see our desolation, and the city upon which Your name is called; for not on account of our righteousness do we lay our supplications before You, but on account of Your abundant mercy. My Lord, hear; my Lord, forgive; my Lord, listen and act, do not delay, for Your own sake, my God, for Your name is called upon Your city and Your people. Our Father, merciful Father, show us a sign for good, and gather our scattered ones from the four corners of the earth. Let all the nations recognize and know that You, Hashem, are our Father. We are the clay and You are our Potter, and we are all the work of Your hand. Our Father, our King, our Rock and our Redeemer, spare Your people, Hashem, and do not make Your inheritance a reproach, for the nations to rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, “Where is their God?” We know, Hashem, that we have sinned, and there is no one to stand up for us but Your great Name; let it stand by us in time of trouble. As a father has compassion for his children, have compassion on us. Pity Your people and have mercy on Your inheritance. Spare us, please, in Your abundant mercy; be gracious to us, our King, and answer us. Yours, Hashem, is righteousness; You work wonders at all times. Look, please, and save, please, the flock of Your pasture. Let no wrath rule over us, for Yours, Hashem, is the salvation; in You is our hope. God of forgiveness, please, forgive. For You are a good and forgiving God.

We beseech You, gracious and compassionate King: remember and look to the Covenant between the Pieces, and let the binding of the only one appear before You, and for the sake of Israel our father. Do not abandon us, our Father; do not cast us off, our King; do not forget us, our Maker; and do not make an end of us in our exile. For You are a gracious and compassionate God and King.

There is none like You, gracious and compassionate, our God; there is none like You, God slow to anger and abounding in kindness and truth. Save us and have mercy on us; from tumult and wrath deliver us. Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; do not look to the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin. Turn from Your burning anger and relent from the evil to Your people. And remove from us the plague of death, for You are compassionate; for such is Your way, to do kindness freely in every generation. Please, Hashem, save us, please; please, Hashem, grant us success, please. Please, Hashem, answer us on the day we call. For You, Hashem, we have hoped; for You, Hashem, we have waited; for You, Hashem, we have longed; do not be silent, and answer us. For the nations say: their hope is lost. Every knee shall bow to You, and every upright one shall prostrate before You.

You who open Your hand in repentance to receive transgressors and sinners: our soul is dismayed by the abundance of our sorrow. Do not forget us forever; arise and save us. Do not pour out Your wrath upon us, for we are Your people, the children of Your covenant. God, look! Our honor has been diminished among the nations, and they abhor us as something impure. How long will Your strength be in captivity, and Your glory in the hand of the foe? Let them see and be ashamed, let them be dismayed at their might. Awaken Your might and save us for the sake of Your Name. Let our troubles not be small before You; let Your mercies quickly come to meet us in the time of our distress. Not for our sake but for Yours, act, and do not destroy the remembrance of our remnant. For our eyes look to You, for You are a gracious and compassionate God and King. And remember our testimony every day continually, we who say twice daily with love: “Hear, O Israel, Hashem is our God, Hashem is One.”

segs.en: Penitential Prayers for the Tenth of Tevet
segs.text: סליחות לעשרה בטבת

segs.en: After the repetition, say the Confession and Nefilat Apayim (Falling on the Face), and then say:
segs.text: <small>אחר החזרה אומרים וידוי ונפילת אפים, ואחר כך אומרים</small>

וָאָרֶץ שָׁפַל רוּמִי, וְגָדַל שִׁבְרִי, מְשׁוֹמֵם אֵשֵׁב, יוֹם סָמַךְ הָאֲרִי, עַל צְבִי הַר קֹדֶשׁ צִיּוֹן עִירִי, לָכֵן אֲקוֹנֵן וְאֶתְאַבֵּל בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי אַרְיֵה עָלָה בְחֵמָה, בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּנָה עָלַי חוֹמָה, גָּשׁ הוּא וְכָל־עַמּוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּעַמִּי נְקָמָה, וַיַּעַרְכוּ אִתָּם מִלְחָמָה: מִלְחָמָה שִׁית מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמוֹשִׁיעִי, בְּאוֹיְבִי וּמַכְנִיעִי, כּוֹס מָלֵא מֶסֶךְ הַשְׁקֵם יְהֹוָה רוֹעִי, מָגִּנִּי וְקֶרֶן יִשְׁעִי:

בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי דְּלָקַנִי אוֹיֵב בַּחֶרֶב, בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הֵכִין עָלַי אוֹרֵב, וְעַל זֹאת אֲקוֹנֵן וְגִילִי עָרֵב, אוֹי לָנוּ כִּי פָנָה הַיּוֹם, כִּי יִנָּטוּ צִלְלֵי־עָרֶב: עֶרֶב יֵהָפֵךְ לְבֹקֶר וּבוֹגְדִים אַל יַעֲלוּ עָל, חֹן עַל עַמְּךָ וְלִכְאֵבָם הַעֲלֵה תַעַל, זְכֹר־לִי בְּרִית אָבוֹת, בְּפָּרְשִׂי לְךָ כַּף וְשַׁעַל, מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה, מוֹרִיד שְׁאוֹל וַיָּעַל:

בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי זְאֵב עֲרָבוֹת עַל עַמִּי נוֹהֵם, בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ, טָרֹף טֹרַף כָּל־הַיּוֹצֵא מֵהֶם, נָמֵר שֹׁקֵד עַל עָרֵיהֶם: עָרֵיהֶם שָֽׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ בִּרְבוֹת תְּלָאוֹת, רוּמָה יְהֹוָה בְּעֻזֶּךָ זֵדִים לְהַשְׁאוֹת, בּוֹשׁ יֵבוֹשׁוּ בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ עִמָּנוּ לְטוֹבָה אוֹת, קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת:

בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי יְדֵי צַר הֶחֱזִֽיקוּ מָגֵן וְצִנָּה, בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ כְּאִישׁ עָרוּךְ לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל קִרְיָה נֶאֱמָנָה, לְזֹאת חִגְרִי שַׂק עֵדָה עֲדִינָה, גָּזִּי נִזְרֵךְ וְהַשְׁלִיכִי, וּשְׂאִי עַל שְׁפָיִם קִינָה: קִינָה דוֹבֵר עַמְּךָ בְּיוֹם זֶה לְעֻמָּתֶךָ, וְעַפְעַפֵּֽינוּ יִזְּלוּ מַיִם עַל חָרְבָּן בֵּיתֶךָ, יוֹם נָקָם תָּעִיר לְצָּרִים הוֹמִים בְּבֵיתֶךָ, דְּרָכֶיךָ יְהֹוָה הוֹדִיעֵנִי וְלַמְּדֵנִי אוֹרְחוֹתֶיךָ:

בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי מֹנַי שָֽׁפְכוּ עַל עִירִי סוֹלְלָה, בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ נִזְרִי הַשְׁלַךְ וְתִפְאַרְתִּי נָֽפְלָה, סְבָבוּנִי הָעֹשִׂים מַכָּתִי נַחְלָה, מֵעַי מֵעַי אוֹחִילָה: אוֹחִילָה יוֹם זֶה לְנַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד קְדוֹשִׁים רַבָּה, וַאֲחַלֶּה פָנָיו לַעֲבֹר עַל פֶּשַׁע וְחוֹבָה, אַל תֵּפֶן לְרִשְׁעֵנוּ וּמְחֵה חַטָּאת כְּתוּבָה, הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה:

עַל יְדֵי רַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִֽינוּ, כִּי בְרֹב אִוַּלְתֵּנוּ שָׁגִֽינוּ: מְחֹל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, כִּי רַבּוּ עֲוֹנֵֽינוּ: אֵל אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם אַתָּה, וְדֶרֶךְ תְּשׁוּבָה לָנוּ הוֹרֵיתָ: גְּדֻלַּת רַחֲמֶיךָ וַחֲסָדֶיךָ, תִּזְכֹּר הַיּוֹם לְזֶרַע יְדִידֶיךָ: תֵּפֶן אֵלֵֽינוּ בְּרַחֲמִים, כִּי אַתָּה הוּא בַּעַל הָרַחֲמִים: בְּתַחֲנוּן וּבִתְפִלָּה נְקַדֵּם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם: וּמֵחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ תָּשׁוּב, כְּמוֹ בְּתוֹרָֽתְךָ כָּתוּב: וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ נֶחֱסֶה וְנִתְלוֹנָן, כְּיוֹם וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן: תַּעֲבוֹר עַל פֶּשַׁע וְתִמְחֹל אָשָׁם, כְּיוֹם וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם: תַּאֲזִין שֶׁוַע וְתַקְשִׁיב בְּרָצוֹן מַאֲמָר, כְּיוֹם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה: וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙:

segs.en: According to the order of Aleph-Bet
segs.text: <small>על סדר א"ב</small>

אָז בְּבוֹא יוֹם פְּקֻדַּת גֵּיא הַמַּחֲזֶה, בַּחֲרוֹת אַף יְהֹוָה בְּרִשְׁפֵּי אַזֶּה, גִּלָּה בְּיַד בֶּן־בּוּזִי הַחוֹזֶה: כְּתׇוב־לְךָ֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם הַיּ֔וֹם אֶת־עֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה: דִּבַּרְתִּי בְּאֵשׁ קִנְאָתִי בֵּית מְרִי לִסְפּוֹת, הִנְנִי אֵלֶיהָ בְּאַף וְרוּחַ זִלְעָפוֹת: וְשַׂמְתִּיהָ לְמָשָׁל וְלִשְׁנִינָה וְלַחֲרָפוֹת, שְׁפֹת הַסִּיר שְׁפֹת: זַלְעָפָה אָחֲזָה צִיּוֹן וְהֵיכָלֶיהָ, חָֽרְדָה רוּחָהּ נָמוֹגוּ חֲיָלֶיהָ, טֹרַף לִבָּהּ עֵת קְרֹא אֵלֶיהָ, אֱסֹ֤ף נְתָחֶ֙יהָ֙ אֵלֶ֔יהָ: יְרִיבֶיהָ אַעֲנִיק שְׁבִי וּמַלְקֹחַ, כֹּהֲנֶיהָ וּמֶרְקָחֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר רָֽקְחָה רָקֹחַ, לִשְׁבִי עוֹלָם מֵאֵין פְּקַח קֹחַ, מִבְחַ֤ר הַצֹּאן֙ לָק֔וֹחַ: מָֽשְׁלוּ בָךְ לָעֲגוּ מוֹשֶׁלֶת עַמִּים, נִקְרֵאת אָז נוֹדַעַתְ, מְאוּסַת עוֹלָמִים, שׂוֹטְנִים יַעֲנוּ בָךְ וְעָלַיִךְ נוֹאֲמִים, אוֹי֮ עִ֣יר הַדָּמִים֒: עָֽבְרָה עֲבֵרָה סָרָה הֵפֵרָה בְּרִית יָהּ, פָּֽשְׁעָה רָֽשְׁעָה טָֽבְעָה בְּבוֹר תַּחְתִּיָּה, צָעֲקָה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֵל בִּכְיָהּ, כִּ֤י דָמָהּ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֣הּ הָיָ֔ה: קוֹל עֲשׁוּקֶיהָ שְׁמַע מִיַּד עוֹשְׁקָם, רִגְשָׁתָם וְצַוְחָתָם לֹא תָשִׁיב רֵיקָם, שִׁבְעָתַיִם תְּשַׁלֵּם כְּפָעֳלָם אֶל חֵיקָם, שֶׁ֨בַע ׀ יִפּ֣וֹל צַדִּ֣יק וָקָ֑ם: תָּעִֽינוּ בְרִשְׁעֵנוּ אֵל גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא, וְאִם גָּֽבְרוּ פְשָׁעֵֽינוּ חֶמְלָֽתְךָ גָֽבְרָה, רִחַמְתָּ וְכִמְעַט קָט כִּלִּיתָם בְּעֶבְרָה, צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא, וּבְשֵֽׁם־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א: יֶהֱמוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ עַל מְעוּטֵי עַמִּים, וְשַׂגְּבֵם בְּחַסְדְּךָ, לְעֵינֵי כָל־לְאֻמִּים, פְּלָאֶיךָ הַרְאֵם צוּר שׁוֹכֵן מְרוֹמִים, אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים:

שְׁעֵה עֶלְיוֹן, לְקוֹל אֶבְיוֹן, וְשַׁוְעָתוֹ אַל תִּבְזֶה: לְבָבוֹ מַר, בְּיוֹם נֶאֱמַר, לְבֶן בּוּזִי הַחוֹזֶה: כְּתׇוב־לְךָ֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם הַיּ֔וֹם אֶת־עֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה: יָהּ צְבָאוֹת, זְכוֹר תְּלָאוֹת, אֲשֶׁר צַר לִי מאֹד עֲלֵיהֶן: בְּמַזַּל גְּדִי, הֲלֹא בַעֲדִי, נֶאֶסְפוּ שְׁלֹשְׁתֵּיהֶן: וּבוֹ שֵׂיוֹת, הַדְּחוּיוֹת, חַל הַנֶּגֶף בָּהֶן: וּבוֹ סָמַךְ, מְנָאֵץ שְׁמָךְ, עַל קִרְיַת מְשׂוֹשֵׂיהֶן: וּבוֹ נֶאֱסַף רֹאשׁ הַסָּף, הוּא עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן: כָּל־אֵלֶּה, קְרָאוּנִי וְרַבּוֹת כָּזֶה וְכָזֶה: אֲרִי עָלַז, בְּיוֹם הַלָּז, וְחֵץ קִלְקֵל לְמוּל עִירִי: וְקָם עֲשִׂירִי, בָּעֲשִׂירִי, לְשַׁחֵת כָּל־שְׁאָר הָעֲשִׂירִי: לְאַבֵּד כָֹּל, פְּרִי אֶשְׁכֹּל, וְלִלְקוֹט עִנְּבֵי נְזִירִי: וְעוֹד קָשׁוּר, אֲנִי לְאַשּׁוּר, אֲשֶׁר נִצָּב עַל צִירִי: אֲנִי נִגְדָּע, וְלֹא אֵדַע, לְמִי אֶבְכֶּה הֲזֶה אוֹ זֶה: סְמֹךְ עַמָּךְ, בְּיוֹם סָמַךְ, אֲרִי עַל עִיר צְבִי קֹדֶשׁ: שְׁעֵה שַׁוְעָם, מְחֵה פִשְׁעָם, בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ: וְהַמְּלוּכָה, הַנְּסוּכָה, כִּימֵי קֶדֶם חַדֵּשׁ: וְלִתְהִלָּה, כְּבַתְּחִלָּה, שִׁמְךָ יָהּ בָּנוּ קַדֵּשׁ: וְכָל־שׂוֹנֵא, וּמִתְאַנֶּה, בְּעֹז אַפְּךָ הָדֵּשׁ: וְיִלָּֽכְדוּ, וְיֹאבְדוּ, כְּיוֹם בָּרָק בְּעִיר קֶדֶשׁ: וְשׁוּב עֶלְיוֹן, לְעִיר צִיּוֹן, עַיִן בְּעַיִן נֶחֱזֶה: וְאָז נֹאמַר, בְּטוּב מַאֲמָר, הִנֵּה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ זֶה:

יוֹשֵׁב בַּשָּׁמַיִם, שְׁעֵה בָּאֵי בָאֵשׁ וּבַמָּיִם: וְחֹן עַל עַם אֲשֶׁר לָקוּ, בְחַטֹּאתָם כִּפְלָיִם: בְּיוֹם הֵחֵל צַר לָצוּר מְחוֹלַת מַחֲנַיִם, סָמַךְ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל אֶל יְרוּשָׁלָיִם: הָעוֹנֶה בַּמֵּצָר, עֱנוּת עָנִי אַל תִּבְזֶה: בְּיוֹם צוֹם הָעֲשִׂירִי, עֱנוּתֵנוּ תֶּחֱזֶה: יוֹם הִזְהַרְתָּ בַּמַּחֲזֶה, לְבֶן־בּוּזִי הַחוֹזֶה: כְּתׇוב־לְךָ֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם הַיּ֔וֹם אֶת־עֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה: יוֹם בּוֹ שָׁקַד שַׁחַל, וְנָמֵר עַל דְּלַתָיִם: יוֹם סָֽמְּכוּ עַל אַרְמוֹן נַחֲלַת צְבִי וָשֶׁפֶר, וּבוֹ הוּחַל הַנֶּגֶף בְּמַכְפִּישֵׁי בָּאֵפֶר: וְגַם בּוֹ נֶאֱסַף, עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן הַסּוֹפֵר: וְלֵב מְתֵי קִרְיַת סֵפֶר, בּוֹ הָיָה לְמָיִם, סָמַךְ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל אֶל יְרוּשָׁלָיִם:

אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים וּמִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ, מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן. מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לַחַטָּאִים, וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים. עֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל־בָּשָׂר וְרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם לָהֶם גּוֹמֵל. אֵל הוֹרֵתָנוּ לוֹמַר מִדּוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, זְכֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙׃

אַנְשֵׁי אֱמוּנָה אָבָדוּ, בָּאִים בְּכֹחַ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם: גִּבּוֹרִים לַעֲמֹד בַּפֶּרֶץ, דּוֹחִים אֶת־הַגְּזֵרוֹת: הָיוּ לָנוּ לְחוֹמָה, וּלְמַחְסֶה בְּיוֹם זָעַם: זוֹעֲכִים אַף בְּלַחֲשָׁם, חֵמָה עָֽצְרוּ בְּשַׁוְּעָם: טֶרֶם קְרָאוּךָ עֲנִיתָם, יוֹדְעִים לַעֲתֹר וּלְרַצּוֹת: כְּאָב רִחַמְתָּ לְמַעֲנָם, לֹא הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ פְנֵיהֶם רֵיקָם: מֵרֹב עֲוֹנֵֽינוּ אֲבַדְנוּם, נֶאֶסְפוּ מֶנּוּ בַּחֲטָאֵֽינוּ: סָעוּ הֵמָּה לִמְנוּחוֹת, עָֽזבוּ אוֹתָנוּ לַאֲנָחוֹת: פַּסּוּ גוֹדְרֵי גָדֵר, צֻמְּתוּ מְשִׁיבֵי חֵמָה: קָמִים בַּפֶּרֶץ אַיִן, רְאוּיִים לְרַצּוֹתְךָ אָפֵסוּ: שׁוֹטַטְנוּ בְּאַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת, תְּרוּפָה לֹא מָצָאנוּ: שַׁבְנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּבֹשֶׁת פָּנֵֽינוּ, לְשַׁחֲרָךְ אֵל בְּעֵת צָרוֹתֵֽינוּ:

אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים וּמִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ, מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן. מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לַחַטָּאִים, וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים. עֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל־בָּשָׂר וְרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם לָהֶם גּוֹמֵל. אֵל הוֹרֵתָנוּ לוֹמַר מִדּוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, זְכֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙׃

segs.en: According to the order of Tesh-Rak
segs.text: <small>על סדר תשר"ק</small>

תָּמַהְנוּ מֵרָעוֹת, תָּשַׁשׁ כֹּחֵנוּ מִצָּרוֹת. שַׁחְנוּ עַד לִמְאֹד, שָׁפַלְנוּ עַד עָפָר. רַחוּם כָּךְ הִיא מִדָּתֵנוּ, קְשֵׁי עֹרֶף וּמַמְרִים אֲנַחְנוּ. צָעַקְנוּ בְּפִֽינוּ חָטָאנוּ, פְּתַלְתּוֹל וְעִקֵּשׁ לִבֵּנוּ. עֶלְיוֹן רַחֲמֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם, סְלִיחָה עִמְּךָ הִיא. נִחָם עַל הָרָעָה, מַטֵּה כְלַפֵּי חֶסֶד. לֹא תִתְעַלַּם בְּעִתּוֹת כָּאֵל, כִּי בְצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָחְנוּ. יִוָּדַע לְעֵינֵי הַכֹּל, טוּבְךָ וְחַסְדְּךָ עִמָּנוּ. חֲתֹם פֶּה־שָׂטָן, וְאַל יַשְׂטִין עָלֵֽינוּ, זְעֹם בּוֹ וְיִדֹּם. וְיַעֲמֹד מֵלִיץ טוֹב לְצַדְּקֵנוּ, הוּא יַגִּיד יָשְׁרֵנוּ. דְּרָכֶיךָ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן גִּלִּיתָ לְנֶאֱמַן בָּיִת. בְּבַקְשׁוֹ אָז מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, אֱמוּנָֽתְךָ הוֹדַעְתָּ לּוֹ:

אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים וּמִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ, מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן. מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לַחַטָּאִים, וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים. עֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל־בָּשָׂר וְרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם לָהֶם גּוֹמֵל. אֵל הוֹרֵתָנוּ לוֹמַר מִדּוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, זְכֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙׃

וּכְשֶׁחָֽטְאוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר, עָמַד מֹשֶׁה בִּתְפִלָּה לְפָנֶיךָ, וּבִקֵּשׁ רַחֲמִים עַל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָךְ אָמַר בִּתְפִלָּתוֹ: סְלַֽח־נָ֗א לַעֲוֺ֛ן הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּגֹ֣דֶל חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתָה֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־הֵֽנָּה׃ אַף אַתָּה הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ לוֹ כְּדַרְכֵי טוּבְךָ בִּשַּׂרְתּוֹ וַחֲנַנְתּוֹ וְאָמַרְתָּ לוֹ: סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶךָ:

דָּנִיֵּאל אִישׁ חֲמוּדוֹת אָמַר לְפָנֶיךָ: הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י ׀ אׇזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשְׁמָע֒ פקחה [פְּקַ֣ח] עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י ׀ לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃ אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקְשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעַנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃ וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִירָךְ אָמַרְתָּ לָהּ: הִנְנִי֙ נִשְׁפָּ֣ט אוֹתָ֔ךְ עַל־אׇמְרֵ֖ךְ לֹ֥א חָטָֽאתִי׃ אֲנַחְנוּ בּוֹשְׁנוּ בְּמַעֲשֵֽׂינוּ וְנִכְלַמְנוּ בַּעֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֵין לָנוּ פֶּה לְהָשִׁיב וְלֹא מֵצַח לְהָרִים רֹאשׁ:

segs.en: According to the order of Aleph-Tet, Bet-Shin
segs.text: <small>על סדר א"ת ב"ש</small>

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אַל תַּעַשׂ עִמָּנוּ כָּלָה, תֹּאחֵז יָֽדְךָ בַּמִּשְׁפָּט. בְּבֹא תוֹכֵחָה נֶגְדֶּךָ, שְׁמֵנוּ מִסִּפְרְךָ אַל תֶּמַח. גִּשְׁתְּךָ לַחֲקֹר מוּסָר, רַחֲמֶיךָ יְקַדְּמוּ רָגְזֶךָ. דַּלּוּת מַעֲשִׂים בְּשׁוּרֶךָ, קָרֵב צֶדֶק מֵאֵלֶיךָ. הוֹרֵנוּ בְּזַעֲקֵנוּ לָךְ, צַו יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ בְּמַפְגִּיעַ. וְתָשִׁיב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי תָם, פְּתָחָיו רְאֵה כִּי שָׁמֵמוּ. זְכֹר נָאַמְתָּ, עֵדוּת לֹא תִשָּׁכַח מִפִּי זַרְעוֹ. חוֹתָם תְּעוּדָה תַּתִּיר, סוֹדְךָ שִׂים בְּלִמּוּדֶיךָ. טַבּוּר אַגַּן הַסַּהַר, נָא אַל יֶחְסַר הַמָּזֶג. יָהּ דַּע אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יְדָעוּךָ, מַגֵּר אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדָעוּךָ. כִּי תָשִׁיב לְבִצָּרוֹן, לְכוּדִים אֲסִירֵי הַתִּקְוָה:

אָשַׁמְנוּ מִכָּל־עָם, בֹּשְׁנוּ מִכָּל־גּוֹי. גָּלָה מִמֶּנּוּ מָשׂוֹשׂ, דָּוֶה לִבֵּנוּ בַּחֲטָאֵֽינוּ. הָחְבַּל אֶוְיֵֽינוּ, וְנִפְרָע פְּאֵרֵנוּ. זְבוּל מִקְדָּשֵׁנוּ, חָרֵב בַּעֲוֹנֵֽינוּ. טִירָתֵנוּ הָֽיְתָה לְשַׁמָּה, יְפִי אַדְמָתֵנוּ לְזָרִים, כֹּחֵנוּ לְנָכְרִים. לְעֵינֵינוּ עָֽשְׁקוּ עֲמָלֵנוּ, מְמֻשָּׁךְ וּמוֹרָט מִמֶּנּוּ. נָֽתְנוּ עֻלָּם עָלֵֽינוּ, סָבַלְנוּ עַל שִׁכְמֵנוּ. עֲבָדִים מָֽשְׁלוּ בָנוּ, פּוֹרֵק אֵין מִיָּדָם. צָרוֹת רַבּוֹת סְבָבוּנוּ, קְרָאנוּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ. רָחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנּוּ בַּעֲוֹנֵֽינוּ, שַׁבְנוּ מֵאַחֲרֶיךָ, תָּעִֽינוּ כַּצֹּאן וְאָבָֽדְנוּ. וַעֲדַיִן לֹא שַׁבְנוּ מִתְּעִיָּתֵנוּ, וְהֵיאַךְ נָעִיז פָּנֵֽינוּ, וְנַקְשֶׁה עָרְפֵּנוּ, לוֹמַר לְפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַחְנוּ וְלֹא־חָטָאנוּ:

עֶזְרָא הַסּוֹפֵר אָמַר לְפָנֶיךָ: אֱלֹהַי֙ בֹּ֣שְׁתִּי וְנִכְלַ֔מְתִּי לְהָרִ֧ים אֱלֹהַ֛י פָּנַ֖י אֵלֶ֑יךָ כִּ֣י עֲוֺנֹתֵ֤ינוּ רָבוּ֙ לְמַ֣עְלָה רֹּ֔אשׁ וְאַשְׁמָתֵ֥נוּ גָדְלָ֖ה עַ֥ד לַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ וְאַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת, חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם, אֶרֶךְ־אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד, וְלֹא עֲזַבְתָּם. אַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ אָבִֽינוּ, אַל תִּטְּשֵׁנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, וְאַל תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ יוֹצְרֵנוּ, וְאַל תַּעַשׂ עִמָּנוּ כָלָה בְּגָלוּתֵנוּ, וְקַיֵּם לָנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּנוּ, עַל יְדֵי יִרְמְיָה חוֹזָךְ, כָּאָמוּר: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֩ וּבָעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜יא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה יְבֻקַּ֞שׁ אֶת־עֲוֺ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאֵינֶ֔נּוּ וְאֶת־חַטֹּ֥את יְהוּדָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תִמָּצֶ֑אינָה כִּ֥י אֶסְלַ֖ח לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אַשְׁאִֽיר׃ וְאַל יְעַכֵּב לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל־חֵטְא וְעוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ, וּמְחוֹל וּסְלַח לְכָל־עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וסַלָּח אָתָּה:

מַה־נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מָרוֹם, וּמַה נְּסַפֵּר לְפָנֶיךָ שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים, הֲלֹא הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת וְהַנִּגְלוֹת אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ, אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ רָזֵי עוֹלָם, וְתַעֲלוּמוֹת סִתְרֵי כָל־חָי, אַתָּה חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל־חַדְרֵי בָטֶן, רֹאֶה כְלָיוֹת וָלֵב. אֵין דָּבָר נֶעְלָם מִמָּךְ, וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ:

יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁתִּמְחֹל לָנוּ אֶת־כָּל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ, וּתְכַפֵּר לָנוּ אֶת־כָּל־עֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ, וְתִמְחֹל וְתִסְלַח לְכָל־פְּשָׁעֵינוּ, וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ: סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ, מְחֹל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי פָשָֽׁעְנוּ: כִּי אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי, טוֹב וְסַלָּח, וְרַב־חֶסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ: לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃ לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓ ׀ תּוֹצִ֖יא מִצָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֨נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַֽעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ׃ הֲשִׁיבֵ֨נוּ יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ ונשוב [וְֽנָשׁ֔וּבָה] חַדֵּ֥שׁ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם׃

וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם ׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַֽ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־יָ֝עִ֗יר כׇּל־חֲמָתֽוֹ׃ אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹֽא־תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ ׀ יְהֹ֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ: אִם־עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמׇר־יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃ כִּֽי־עִמְּךָ֥ הַסְּלִיחָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן תִּוָּרֵֽא׃ לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃ אִם־עֲוֺנֵ֙ינוּ֙ עָ֣נוּ בָ֔נוּ יְהֹוָ֕ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ׃ זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃ יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ מַעֲשִׂים. עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ צְדָקָה כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ:

parts.text: אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ הוֹצֵ֨אתָ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֜ מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה וַתַּֽעַשׂ־לְךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה חָטָ֖אנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃ אֲדֹנָ֗י כְּכׇל־צִדְקֹתֶ֙ךָ֙ יָֽשׇׁב־נָ֤א אַפְּךָ֙ וַחֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ מֵעִֽירְךָ֥ יְרוּשָׁלַ֖‍ִם הַר־קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ כִּ֤י בַחֲטָאֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּבַעֲוֺנ֣וֹת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ֧‍ִם וְעַמְּךָ֛ לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לְכָל־סְבִיבֹתֵֽינוּ׃ וְעַתָּ֣ה ׀ שְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְאֶל־תַּ֣חֲנוּנָ֔יו וְהָאֵ֣ר פָּנֶ֔יךָ עַל־מִקְדָּשְׁךָ֖ הַשָּׁמֵ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן אֲדֹנָֽי׃ הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י ׀ אׇזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשְׁמָע֒ פקחה [פְּקַ֣ח] עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י ׀ לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃ אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקְשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעַנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃ אָבִינוּ אָב הָרַחֲמָן,

הַרְאֵנוּ אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְקַבֵּץ נְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ. יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל הַגּוֹיִם כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אָבִינוּ אָתָּה. אֲנַחְנוּ הַחֹמֶר וְאַתָּה יֹצְרֵנוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדְךָ כֻּלָּנוּ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ,

ח֧וּסָה יְהֹוָ֣ה עַל־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וְאַל־תִּתֵּ֨ן נַחֲלָתְךָ֤ לְחֶרְפָּה֙ לִמְשׇׁל־בָּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם לָ֚מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ בָעַמִּ֔ים אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ יָדַעְנוּ יְהֹוָה כִּי חָטָאנוּ. וְאֵין מִי יַעֲמוֹד בַּעֲדֵנוּ אֶלָּא שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל יַעֲמוֹד לָנוּ בְּעֵת צָרָה. וּכְרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ. חֲמֹל עַל עַמָּךְ וְרַחֵם עַל נַחֲלָתָךְ. חוּסָה נָּא כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ חָנֵּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַצְּדָקָה עוֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת בְּכָל עֵת וָעֵת. הַבֵּט נָא וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא צֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ. אַל יִמְשָׁל בָּנוּ קֶצֶף כִּי לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיְשׁוּעָה בְּךָ תוֹחַלְתֵּנוּ. אֱלוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת אָנָּא סְלַח נָא. כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָתָּה:

segs.text: אָנָּא מֶלֶךְ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן, זְכוֹר וְהַבֵּט לִבְרִית בֵּין הַבְּתָרִים. וְתֵרָאֶה לְפָנֶיךָ עֲקֵדַת יָחִיד. וּלְמַעַן יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִינוּ. אַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ אָבִינוּ. וְאַל תִּטְּשֵׁנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וְאַל תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ יוֹצְרֵנוּ. וְאַל תַּעַשׂ עִמָּנוּ כָלָה בְּגָלוּתֵינוּ. כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה:

אֵין כָּמוֹךָ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֱלֹהֵינוּ. אֵין כָּמוֹךָ אֵל אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת. הושִׁיעֵנוּ וְרַחֲמֵנוּ מֵרַעַשׁ וּמֵרֹגֶז הַצִּילֵנוּ: זְכֹר֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב אַל־תֵּ֗פֶן אֶל־קְשִׁי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאֶל־רִשְׁע֖וֹ וְאֶל־חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃ שׁ֚וּב מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔ךָ וְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־הָרָעָ֖ה לְעַמֶּֽךָ׃ וְהָסֵר מִמֶּנּוּ מַכַּת הַמָּוֶת כִּי רַחוּם אָתָּה. כִּי כֵן דַּרְכְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת חֶסֶד חִנָּם בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָנָּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָֽא׃ אָנָּא יְהֹוָה עֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵנוּ: לְךָ יְהֹוָה קִוִּינוּ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה חִכִּינוּ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה נְיַחֵל אַל תֶּחֱשֶׁה וּתְעַנֵּנוּ. כִּי נָאֲמוּ גוֹיִם אָבְדָה תִקְוָתָם. כָּל בֶּרֶךְ לְךָ תִכְרַע וְכָל קוֹמָה לְפָנֶיךָ תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה:

הַפּוֹתֵחַ יָד בִּתְשׁוּבָה לְקַבֵּל פּוֹשְׁעִים וְחַטָּאִים. נִבְהֲלָה נַפְשֵׁנוּ מֵרוֹב עִצְּבוֹנֵנוּ. אַל תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ נֶצַח קוּמָה וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. אַל תִּשְׁפּוֹךְ חֲרוֹנְךָ עָלֵינוּ כִּי עַמְּךָ אֲנַחְנוּ בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ. אֵל הַבִּיטָה. דַּל כְּבוֹדֵנוּ בַגּוֹיִם וְשִׁקְּצוּנוּ כְּטֻמְאַת הַנִּדָּה. עַד מָתַי עֻזְּךָ בַּשְּׁבִי וְתִפְאַרְתְּךָ בְּיַד צָר. הֵמָּה יִרְאוּ וְיֵבשׁוּ וְיֵחַתּוּ מִגְּבוּרָתָם. עוֹרְרָה גְבוּרָתְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ. אַל יִמְעֲטוּ לְפָנֶיךָ תְּלָאוֹתֵינוּ מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ בְּעֵת צָרוֹתֵנוּ. לֹא לְמַעֲנֵנוּ אֶלָּא לְמַעֲנָךְ פְּעֹל וְאַל תַּשְׁחֵת אֶת זֵכֶר שְׁאֵרִיתֵנוּ. כִּי לְךָ מְיַחֲלוֹת עֵינֵינוּ כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה. וּזְכוֹר עֵדוּתֵינוּ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד אוֹמְרִים פַּעֲמַיִם בְּאַהֲבָה: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ אֶחָֽד׃

segs.en: The chazzan says Half Kaddish, the Torah is taken out, three people are called for the reading of Vayechel, and the service concludes as on any other day. After Hoshi'enu, say the Psalm of Asaf, 'Elohim, El Dami Lecha,' as in the morning service.
segs.text: <small>ואומר הש"ץ חצי קדיש, ומוציאים ס"ת וקוראים ג' עולים בפרשת ויחל, וגומרים התפלה כבכל יום, ואחר הושיענו אומרים שיר מזמור לאסף, אלהים אל דמי לך לעיל בתפלת שחרית.</small>
Penitential Prayers for the Tenth of Tevet

parts.text: After the repetition of the Amidah (standing prayer),
we say the Confession and the Falling on the Face (

segs.text: And to the ground was my elevation brought down; my brokenness was enlarged. I sit in desolation on the day the Lion approached the deer, the holy mountain of Zion, my city. Hence I lament and mourn on the tenth month. On the tenth month, the Lion came up in anger, on the tenth of the month he built a wall against me. He approached, he and all of his nation, to take vengeance against me; and they set up a war with them. My lofty One and my Savior, make war against my enemy and my humiliator; make them drink a fully mixed cup (of poison), Lord, my Shepherd, my Shield and the Horn of my salvation!

On the tenth month, the enemy pursued me with a sword. On the tenth of the month, he prepared an ambush for me. And over this I lament, and my joy has waned. Woe to us, as the day is setting, for the shades of the evening are being cast. [May] the evening turn to morning, and the conspirators no longer rise high. Show grace to Your people, and spread a salve on their pain. Remember for me the covenant of the forefathers when I spread out the palms of my hands to You, 'Bringer of death and Giver of life; He who casts down to the grave and brings up.'

On the tenth month, the wolf of the wilderness howls against my people. On the tenth of the month, he devoured all that came out from them. a leopard stalks their cities. They burnt down their cities with fire in the many calamities. Rise up, Lord, to desolate the wanton ones with Your power. They will be greatly shamed when You perform a goodly sign for us, Holy One of Israel, Lord of Hosts!

On the tenth month, the hands of the enemy held a shield and armor. On the tenth of the month, like a man prepared for war against the 'faithful town.' Because of this, gentle community, gird sackcloth; remove your crown and cast it away; raise the dirge to the mountains. Your people calls out a dirge before You on this day, and our eyes flow with water upon the destruction of Your house. Arouse the day of vengeance against the enemies that roar in Your house! 'Let me know Your paths, Lord; teach me Your ways.'

On the tenth month, my oppressors raised an embankment against my city. On the tenth of the month, the ones who made my wound an inheritance surrounded me. 'My innards, my innards, I am shaken!' I am shaken on this day towards the One praised in the great council of the holy ones; I will beseech His presence to forego the rebellion and the guilt: Do not turn to our evil; erase the recorded sin; 'bring us back, Lord, to You and we shall return!'

Through Your abundant mercies, forgive us, our Father, for in the multitude of our folly we have erred; pardon us, our King, for our iniquities are many. You are a God slow to anger, and You have taught us the way of repentance. Remember today the greatness of Your mercies and Your kindnesses for the descendants of Your beloved. Turn to us with compassion, for You are the Master of compassion. With supplication and prayer we come before You, as You made known to the humble one of old. Turn back from Your burning anger, as it is written in Your Torah. In the shadow of Your wings we take refuge and find shelter, as on the day when “Hashem descended in a cloud”; pass over transgression and pardon guilt, as on the day when “He stood with him there”; hear our cry and give ear favorably to our plea, as on the day when “he proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

Then, when the day came, You visited the Valley of Vision; when Hashem’s anger burned with sparks of fire, You revealed it by the hand of the son of Buzi, the seer: “Write down for yourself the name of the day, this very day.” “I have spoken in the fire of My jealousy: to consume the house of rebellion. Behold, I am against her, in anger and with a raging wind; I will make her a proverb, a byword and a reproach. Set on the pot, set it on.” A raging fever seized Zion and her palaces; trembling shook her spirit and her forces melted away; her heart was torn when He called to her: “Gather the pieces into her.” “I will load her adversaries with captives and spoil; her priests and her perfumers, who compounded the compound, to eternal captivity, with none to look on. Take the choicest of the flock.” They mocked you who once ruled the nations; you were called renowned, and then despised for ages; your adversaries answer against you and speak over you: “Woe to the city of blood!” Wrath, wrath: she turned aside, she broke the covenant of Yah; she transgressed, she acted wickedly, she sank in the pit beneath her; she cried out, and God did not hear her weeping, for her blood was in her midst. Hear the voice of those she oppressed, out of the hand of their oppressors; do not send back their clamor and their outcry empty. Repay sevenfold, according to their deeds, into their bosom; seven times the righteous falls and rises. We have strayed through our wickedness, God, great and awesome; and if our transgressions have prevailed, Your compassion has prevailed. You had mercy, though for a little while You consumed them in wrath. “I find trouble and sorrow, and I call upon the name of Hashem.” May Your mercies stir for the smallest of the peoples; raise them high with Your kindness in the sight of all nations. Show them Your wonders, Rock who dwells on high, God, King who sits on the throne of mercy.

Look, Most High, to the voice of the poor man, and do not despise his cry. His heart is bitter on the day when it was said to the son of Buzi, the seer: “Write down for yourself the name of the day, this very day.” Yah of Hosts, remember the hardships over which I am sorely distressed. In the sign of the Kid, were not all three gathered on my account? On it, a plague struck the outcasts among them; on it, the one who blasphemed Your name laid siege to the city of their joys; and on it was gathered the head of the threshold, Ezra the priest. All these befell me, and many more like them. The lion exulted on that day, and an arrow was shaken against my city. And the tenth arose on the tenth, to destroy all that remained of the tenth; to destroy every cluster’s fruit and to gather the grapes of my untrimmed vine. And moreover I am bound to Assyria, which stands upon my hinges; I am cut off, and I do not know over which of these I should weep. Sustain Your people on the day he laid siege, the lion against the city of the holy gazelle. Look upon their cry, wipe out their transgressions, on the tenth of the month. And the kingdom, poured out, renew as in days of old; and for praise, as at the first, sanctify Your name, Yah, through us. And every enemy and everyone who seeks an occasion against us, trample in the might of Your anger; may they be captured and perish, as on the day of lightning in the holy city. And return, Most High, to the city of Zion, and we shall see it eye to eye. And then we shall say in good words: “Behold, this is our God.”

You who dwell in the heavens, look upon those who have come through fire and water, and be gracious to the people who were stricken doubly for their sins. On the day the foe began to besiege, like the dance of two camps, the king of Babylon laid siege to Jerusalem. You who answer in distress, do not despise the affliction of the poor; on the day of the fast of the tenth month, behold our affliction. The day You warned, in a vision, the son of Buzi, the seer: “Write down for yourself the name of the day, this very day.” The day on which the lion kept watch, and the leopard at the doors; the day they laid siege against the palace, the heritage of beauty and splendor; and on it the plague began among those who humbled themselves in ashes; and on it also was gathered Ezra the priest, the scribe. And the heart of the men of Kiriath-Sepher melted like water on it, when the king of Babylon laid siege to Jerusalem.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Hashem descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

Men of faith have perished, those who came by the strength of their deeds, mighty to stand in the breach, who turned away the decrees. They were a wall for us, and a refuge on the day of wrath. They extinguished anger with their whispered prayer and held back fury with their cry. Before they called You, You answered them; they knew how to entreat and to appease. As a father You had compassion for their sake; You did not turn their faces away empty. Through our many iniquities we lost them; they were gathered away from us through our sins. They have gone to their rest and left us to sighing. The builders of the fence have ceased; those who turned back wrath are cut off. None is left standing in the breach; those worthy of appeasing You have ceased. We have wandered to the four corners; we found no remedy. We have come back to You in shame, to seek You, God, in the time of our troubles.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Hashem descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

We are astounded by evils; our strength has failed from troubles. We have sunk exceedingly low; we have been brought down to the dust. Merciful One, such is our nature: we are stiff-necked and rebellious. We cried out with our mouths, “We have sinned,” and our heart is crooked and twisted. Most High, Your mercies are from of old; forgiveness is with You. Relent from the evil; incline toward kindness. Do not hide Yourself in times of trouble, O God, for we are in great distress. Let Your goodness and Your kindness toward us be known before the eyes of all. Seal the mouth of the accuser, and let him not accuse us; rage against him, and let him be silenced. Let a good advocate arise to vindicate us; let him declare our uprightness. Your ways, Merciful and Gracious One, You revealed to the faithful one of the house; when he sought them from You then, You made Your faithfulness known to him.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Hashem descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

When Israel sinned in the wilderness, Moses stood in prayer before You and sought mercy for Your people Israel, and this is what he said in his prayer: “Pardon, please, the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of Your kindness, and as You have borne this people from Egypt until now.” And You, too, answered him in Your good ways, bringing him good tidings and showing him grace, and You said to him: “I have pardoned, as you have asked.”

Daniel, the man most beloved, said before You: “Incline Your ear, my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see our desolation, and the city upon which Your name is called; for not on account of our righteousness do we lay our supplications before You, but on account of Your abundant mercies. My Lord, hear; my Lord, forgive; my Lord, attend and act; do not delay, for Your own sake, my God, for Your name is called upon Your city and upon Your people.” You said to her: “Behold, I will enter into judgment with you for your saying, ‘I have not sinned.’” We are ashamed of our deeds and humiliated by our iniquities; we have no mouth to answer and no boldness to lift our heads.

Our God and God of our fathers, do not make an end of us. Withhold Your hand in judgment when reproof comes before You; do not blot out our name from Your book. Come close to investigate [our] discipline; may Your mercies precede Your anger. Observe our poor deeds; bring righteousness near of Your own accord. Instruct us when we cry to You; command our salvation through the Intercessor. Restore the captivity of the tents of the perfect; see their gates, for they are desolate. Remember the faithful testimony; do not forget it from the mouth of his seed. Loosen the sealed testimony; place Your secret in our learning, the center of the rounded basin: let the mixed wine not be lacking. Yah, know Israel, who have known You; cast down the nations that have not known You. For You will restore to the stronghold the prisoners of hope.

We are guiltier than any people, more ashamed than any nation. Joy has departed from us; our heart is sick through our sins. Our desire has been ruined and our glory stripped away; the dwelling of our Sanctuary lies in ruins through our iniquities. Our palace has become desolate; the beauty of our land is given to strangers, our strength to foreigners. Before our eyes our toil was plundered; what we had was drawn and stripped from us. A yoke was set upon us and we bore it on our shoulder; slaves ruled over us, and none could free us from their hand. Many troubles surrounded us; we called to You, Hashem our God. You were far from us because of our iniquities; we turned back from following You, we strayed like sheep and were lost. And we have not yet turned from our error. How then can we brazenly stiffen our necks, to say before You, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, “We are righteous and have not sinned”?

Ezra the scribe said before You: “My God, I am ashamed and humiliated to lift my face to You, my God, for our iniquities have risen above our heads, and our guilt has grown up to the heavens.” But You are a God of pardons, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in kindness, and You did not forsake them. Do not forsake us, our Father; do not abandon us, our King; do not forget us, our Maker; and do not make an end of us in our exile. And fulfill for us, Hashem our God, the word You promised us through Jeremiah, Your seer, as it is said: “In those days and at that time, declares Hashem, the iniquity of Israel will be sought, and there will be none, and the sins of Judah, and they will not be found, for I will pardon those whom I leave.” Let no sin or iniquity stand in the way of our prayer before You, and pardon and forgive all our iniquities, for You are a good and forgiving God.

What shall we say before You, You who dwell on high, and what shall we recount before You, You who abide in the heavens? Is it not that You know all that is hidden and all that is revealed? You know the secrets of the world and the hidden mysteries of every living being. You search all the chambers of the belly; You see the kidneys and the heart. Nothing is hidden from You, and nothing is concealed from before Your eyes.

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that You forgive us all our sins, atone for all our iniquities, and pardon and forgive all our transgressions; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us as Your inheritance. Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed. For You, Lord, are good and forgiving, abounding in kindness to all who call upon You. For Your name’s sake, Hashem, pardon my iniquity, for it is great. For Your name’s sake, Hashem, You will give me life; in Your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble. Hashem of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our stronghold, Selah. Hashem of Hosts, happy is the person who trusts in You. Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call. Bring us back to You, Hashem, and we shall return; renew our days as of old.

And He, the Merciful, forgives iniquity and does not destroy; He often turns back His anger and does not stir up all His wrath. You, Hashem, will not withhold Your mercies from me; Your kindness and Your truth will always guard me. Save us, Hashem our God, and gather us from the nations, to give thanks to Your holy Name and to glory in Your praise. If You, Yah, should keep iniquities, Lord, who could stand? For with You is forgiveness, so that You may be feared. He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our iniquities. If our iniquities testify against us, Hashem, act for Your name’s sake. Remember Your mercies, Hashem, and Your kindnesses, for they are from of old. May Hashem answer you on the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you. Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call. Our Father, our King, be gracious to us and answer us, for we have no worthy deeds; deal with us in charity according to Your abundant mercy, and save us for Your name’s sake.

And now, my Lord our God, who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and made a name for Yourself, as this very day—we have sinned, we have acted wickedly. My Lord, according to all Your righteous acts, let Your anger and Your wrath turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people have become a reproach to all around us. And now, our God, hear the prayer of Your servant and his supplications, and cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate Sanctuary, for the sake of the Lord. Incline Your ear, my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see our desolation, and the city upon which Your name is called; for not on account of our righteousness do we lay our supplications before You, but on account of Your abundant mercy. My Lord, hear; my Lord, forgive; my Lord, listen and act, do not delay, for Your own sake, my God, for Your name is called upon Your city and Your people. Our Father, merciful Father, show us a sign for good, and gather our scattered ones from the four corners of the earth. Let all the nations recognize and know that You, Hashem, are our Father. We are the clay and You are our Potter, and we are all the work of Your hand. Our Father, our King, our Rock and our Redeemer, spare Your people, Hashem, and do not make Your inheritance a reproach, for the nations to rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, “Where is their God?” We know, Hashem, that we have sinned, and there is no one to stand up for us but Your great Name; let it stand by us in time of trouble. As a father has compassion for his children, have compassion on us. Pity Your people and have mercy on Your inheritance. Spare us, please, in Your abundant mercy; be gracious to us, our King, and answer us. Yours, Hashem, is righteousness; You work wonders at all times. Look, please, and save, please, the flock of Your pasture. Let no wrath rule over us, for Yours, Hashem, is the salvation; in You is our hope. God of forgiveness, please, forgive. For You are a good and forgiving God.

We beseech You, gracious and compassionate King: remember and look to the Covenant between the Pieces, and let the binding of the only one appear before You, and for the sake of Israel our father. Do not abandon us, our Father; do not cast us off, our King; do not forget us, our Maker; and do not make an end of us in our exile. For You are a gracious and compassionate God and King.

There is none like You, gracious and compassionate, our God; there is none like You, God slow to anger and abounding in kindness and truth. Save us and have mercy on us; from tumult and wrath deliver us. Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; do not look to the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin. Turn from Your burning anger and relent from the evil to Your people. And remove from us the plague of death, for You are compassionate; for such is Your way, to do kindness freely in every generation. Please, Hashem, save us, please; please, Hashem, grant us success, please. Please, Hashem, answer us on the day we call. For You, Hashem, we have hoped; for You, Hashem, we have waited; for You, Hashem, we have longed; do not be silent, and answer us. For the nations say: their hope is lost. Every knee shall bow to You, and every upright one shall prostrate before You.

You who open Your hand in repentance to receive transgressors and sinners: our soul is dismayed by the abundance of our sorrow. Do not forget us forever; arise and save us. Do not pour out Your wrath upon us, for we are Your people, the children of Your covenant. God, look! Our honor has been diminished among the nations, and they abhor us as something impure. How long will Your strength be in captivity, and Your glory in the hand of the foe? Let them see and be ashamed, let them be dismayed at their might. Awaken Your might and save us for the sake of Your Name. Let our troubles not be small before You; let Your mercies quickly come to meet us in the time of our distress. Not for our sake but for Yours, act, and do not destroy the remembrance of our remnant. For our eyes look to You, for You are a gracious and compassionate God and King. And remember our testimony every day continually, we who say twice daily with love: “Hear, O Israel, Hashem is our God, Hashem is One.”
